    def __init__(self, topic):
        super().__init__(1)  # Initialize the handler with a 1 Hz publishing rate.

        self.topic = topic
        self.publisher: rclpy.publisher.Publisher = None

import chrono

import chrono.ir

import chrono.ir.chrono_ros

import rospy

from std_msgs.msg import Int32


# Initialize PyChrono environment and core components

system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()


# Set gravitational acceleration

system.AddGravity(-9.81)


# Define physical material properties

material = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()

material.SetFriction(0.5)

material.SetRestitution(0.3)


# Add a fixed floor to the system

floor_shape = chrono.ChBodyFSDynamicsShape()

floor_shape.SetBody("floor")

floor_shape.SetMaterial(material)

floor_shape.SetStatic()

system.AddBody(floor_shape)


# Add a movable box to the system

box_shape = chrono.ChBodyFSDynamicsShape()

box_shape.SetBody("box")

box_shape.SetMaterial(material)

box_shape.SetPosition([0.0, 0.0, 0.0])

system.AddBody(box_shape)


# Create a custom ROS handler to publish integer messages

class IntegerMessageHandler(chrono.ir.chrono_ros.ROSHandler):

    def __init__(self, topic, queue_size=10):

        super().__init__(topic, queue_size)

        self.pub = rospy.Publisher(topic, Int32, queue_size=queue_size)


    def publish(self, value):

        msg = Int32(value)

        self.pub.publish(msg)


# Configure the ROS manager with clock, body, and transform handlers

ros_manager = chrono.ir.chrono_ros.ROSManager()

ros_manager.AddClockHandler(chrono.ir.chrono_ros.ClockHandler())

ros_manager.AddBodyHandler(chrono.ir.chrono_ros.BodyHandler())

ros_manager.AddTransformHandler(chrono.ir.chrono_ros.TransformHandler())


# Register the custom handler

ros_manager.AddROSHandler(IntegerMessageHandler("int_message", 10))


# Run a simulation loop

dt = 0.01  # time step

for step in range(1000):

    # Update the system

    system.DoStepDynamics(dt)


    # Update ROS communication

    if rospy.is_shutdown():

        break

    ros_manager.Update()


    # Publish a message to the ROS topic

    ros_manager.ROSHandler("int_message").publish(step)


    # Maintain real-time execution

    rospy.Rate(1 / dt).sleep()
